passages.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother, and they played in Egypt, prostituting themselves from their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their virgin bosoms caressed.
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me again.
God spoke to me.
He called me "Son of man."
There were two women.
These women were daughters of the same mother.
They lived in Egypt.
They acted as prostitutes from their youth.
In Egypt, men fondled their breasts.
There, men caressed their virgin bosoms.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֑ם שְׁתַּ֣יִם נָשִׁ֔ים בְּנ֥וֹת אֵם־ אַחַ֖ת הָיֽוּ׃ וַתִּזְנֶ֣ינָה בְמִצְרַ֔יִם בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶ֖ן זָנ֑וּ שָׁ֚מָּה מֹעֲכ֣וּ שְׁדֵיהֶ֔ן וְשָׁ֣ם עִשּׂ֔וּ דַּדֵּ֖י בְּתוּלֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah. They became Mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their identities, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
There were two women.
The older woman was named Oholah.
Her sister was named Oholibah.
Both women belonged to God.
They gave birth to sons and daughters.
Oholah represents Samaria.
Oholibah represents Jerusalem.
passages.original: וּשְׁמוֹתָ֗ן אָהֳלָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ וְאָהֳלִיבָ֣ה אֲחוֹתָ֔הּ וַתִּֽהְיֶ֣ינָה לִ֔י וַתֵּלַ֖דְנָה בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֑וֹת וּשְׁמוֹתָ֕ן שֹׁמְר֣וֹן אָהֳלָ֔ה וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָהֳלִיבָֽה׃

passages.text: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians—warriors clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all desirable young men, horsemen mounted on steeds.
passages.sermon:
Oholah was the older sister.
Oholah represents Samaria.
Oholah belonged to God.
Oholah acted unfaithfully while she belonged to God.
Oholah desired her lovers.
Her lovers were the Assyrians.
The Assyrians were warriors.
They wore blue clothing.
They were governors and commanders.
They were all young and desirable men.
They rode horses.
passages.original: וַתִּ֥זֶן אָהֳלָ֖ה תַּחְתָּ֑י וַתַּעְגַּב֙ עַֽל־ מְאַהֲבֶ֔יהָ אֶל־ אַשּׁ֖וּר קְרוֹבִֽים׃ לְבֻשֵׁ֤י תְכֵ֙לֶת֙ פַּח֣וֹת וּסְגָנִ֔ים בַּח֥וּרֵי חֶ֖מֶד כֻּלָּ֑ם פָּרָשִׁ֕ים רֹכְבֵ֖י סוּסִֽים׃

passages.text: She offered sexual favors to all the elite of Assyria. She defiled herself with all the idols of those for whom she lusted.
passages.sermon:
Oholah is Samaria.
Oholah gave herself to the elite men of Assyria.
She offered sexual favors to all of them.
She lusted after these Assyrian men.
She defiled herself with their idols.
She became unclean because of these idols.
passages.original: וַתִּתֵּ֤ן תַּזְנוּתֶ֙יהָ֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מִבְחַ֥ר בְּנֵֽי־ אַשּׁ֖וּר כֻּלָּ֑ם וּבְכֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָֽגְבָ֛ה בְּכָל־ גִּלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם נִטְמָֽאָה׃

passages.text: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when men slept with her in her youth, caressed her virgin bosom, and poured out their lust upon her.
passages.sermon:
Oholah was unfaithful to God.
She began her prostitution in Egypt.
She did not stop this behavior.
Men slept with her when she was young.
They caressed her virgin body.
They poured out their lust on her.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ תַּזְנוּתֶ֤יהָ מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔בָה כִּ֤י אוֹתָהּ֙ שָׁכְב֣וּ בִנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וְהֵ֥מָּה עִשּׂ֖וּ דַּדֵּ֣י בְתוּלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּשְׁפְּכ֥וּ תַזְנוּתָ֖ם עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, the Assyrians for whom she lusted.
passages.sermon:
God acted with judgment.
God gave her over to her lovers.
Her lovers were the Assyrians.
She had desired the Assyrians.
God placed her in the power of those she lusted after.
passages.original: לָכֵ֥ן נְתַתִּ֖יהָ בְּיַד־ מְאַֽהֲבֶ֑יהָ בְּיַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָגְבָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They exposed her nakedness, seized her sons and daughters, and put her to the sword. Thus she became a byword among women, and they executed judgment against her.
passages.sermon:
The Assyrians acted against her.
They exposed her nakedness.
They took her sons.
They took her daughters.
They killed her with the sword.
Women spoke about her as a warning.
People judged her.
passages.original: הֵמָּה֮ גִּלּ֣וּ עֶרְוָתָהּ֒ בָּנֶ֤יהָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ לָקָ֔חוּ וְאוֹתָ֖הּ בַּחֶ֣רֶב הָרָ֑גוּ וַתְּהִי־ שֵׁם֙ לַנָּשִׁ֔ים וּשְׁפוּטִ֖ים עָ֥שׂוּ בָֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah was the sister.
Oholibah saw what happened to her sister.
Oholibah became even more lustful than her sister.
Oholibah acted in prostitution more than her sister did.
Oholibah was more depraved than her sister.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ אֲחוֹתָ֣הּ אָהֳלִיבָ֔ה וַתַּשְׁחֵ֥ת עַגְבָתָ֖הּ מִמֶּ֑נָּה וְאֶת־ תַּ֨זְנוּתֶ֔יהָ מִזְּנוּנֵ֖י אֲחוֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: She too lusted after the Assyrians—governors and commanders, warriors dressed in splendor, horsemen riding on steeds, all desirable young men.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah was the sister.
Oholibah lusted after the Assyrians.
The Assyrians were governors and commanders.
They were warriors dressed in splendor.
They rode on horses.
All of them were young and desirable men.
passages.original: אֶל־ בְּנֵי֩ אַשּׁ֨וּר עָגָ֜בָה פַּח֨וֹת וּסְגָנִ֤ים קְרֹבִים֙ לְבֻשֵׁ֣י מִכְל֔וֹל פָּרָשִׁ֖ים רֹכְבֵ֣י סוּסִ֑ים בַּח֥וּרֵי חֶ֖מֶד כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: And I saw that she too had defiled herself; both of them had taken the same path.
passages.sermon:
God showed me Oholibah.  
Oholibah had defiled herself.  
Her sister had also defiled herself.  
Both sisters chose the same path.  
Both sisters acted in the same way.
passages.original: וָאֵ֖רֶא כִּ֣י נִטְמָ֑אָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ אֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: But Oholibah carried her prostitution even further. She saw the men portrayed on the wall, images of the Chaldeans, engraved in vermilion, wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah was a woman who acted unfaithfully.
She continued in her prostitution.
She saw pictures of men on a wall.
These were images of the Chaldeans.
Artists had engraved these images in red color.
The men wore belts around their waists.
They had flowing turbans on their heads.
All the men looked like officers.
They looked like men from Babylon.
They were Chaldeans.
Babylon was their homeland.
passages.original: וַתּ֖וֹסֶף אֶל־ תַּזְנוּתֶ֑יהָ וַתֵּ֗רֶא אַנְשֵׁי֙ מְחֻקֶּ֣ה עַל־ הַקִּ֔יר צַלְמֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּיִּים חֲקֻקִ֖ים בַּשָּׁשַֽׁר׃ חֲגוֹרֵ֨י אֵז֜וֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶ֗ם סְרוּחֵ֤י טְבוּלִים֙ בְּרָ֣אשֵׁיהֶ֔ם מַרְאֵ֥ה שָׁלִשִׁ֖ים כֻּלָּ֑ם דְּמ֤וּת בְּנֵֽי־ בָבֶל֙ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֶ֖רֶץ מוֹלַדְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: At the sight of them, she lusted for them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah saw the men from Chaldea.
She felt strong desire for them.
She looked at them and wanted them.
She sent messengers to the men in Chaldea.
passages.original: וַתַּעְגַּב עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַרְאֵ֣ה עֵינֶ֑יהָ וַתִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כַּשְׂדִּֽימָה׃

passages.text: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. But after she had been defiled by them, she turned away in disgust.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah was a woman who acted with great unfaithfulness.
The Babylonians came to her.
They came to her for sexual relations.
The Babylonians acted with lust.
They defiled Oholibah through their actions.
Oholibah became unclean because of them.
After this, Oholibah turned away from the Babylonians.
She felt disgusted by them.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ אֵלֶ֤יהָ בְנֵֽי־ בָבֶל֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ב דֹּדִ֔ים וַיְטַמְּא֥וּ אוֹתָ֖הּ בְּתַזְנוּתָ֑ם וַתִּ֨טְמָא־ בָ֔ם וַתֵּ֥קַע נַפְשָׁ֖הּ מֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: When Oholibah openly prostituted herself and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah was a woman who acted unfaithfully.
She openly prostituted herself.
She exposed her nakedness.
I am the Lord God.
I saw her actions.
I turned away from Oholibah in disgust.
I had also turned away from her sister in the same way.
passages.original: וַתְּגַל֙ תַּזְנוּתֶ֔יהָ וַתְּגַ֖ל אֶת־ עֶרְוָתָ֑הּ וַתֵּ֤קַע נַפְשִׁי֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יהָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י מֵעַ֥ל אֲחוֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Yet she multiplied her promiscuity, remembering the days of her youth, when she had prostituted herself in the land of Egypt and lusted after their lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of stallions.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah was a woman who acted with great promiscuity.
She increased her acts of unfaithfulness.
She remembered her youth.
In her youth, she had prostituted herself in Egypt.
She longed for her lovers from Egypt.
These lovers had genitals like donkeys.
Their emission was like that of stallions.
passages.original: וַתַּרְבֶּ֖ה אֶת־ תַּזְנוּתֶ֑יהָ לִזְכֹּר֙ אֶת־ יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָנְתָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ וַֽתַּעְגְּבָ֔ה עַ֖ל פִּֽלַגְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּשַׂר־ חֲמוֹרִים֙ בְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְזִרְמַ֥ת סוּסִ֖ים זִרְמָתָֽם׃

passages.text: So you revisited the indecency of your youth, when the Egyptians caressed your bosom and pressed your young breasts.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah acted with great indecency in her youth.
The Egyptians touched her bosom.
They pressed her young breasts.
Oholibah remembered these acts from her youth.
She returned to this same indecency.
passages.original: וַֽתִּפְקְדִ֔י אֵ֖ת זִמַּ֣ת נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ בַּעְשׂ֤וֹת מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ דַּדַּ֔יִךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁדֵ֥י נְעוּרָֽיִךְ׃ס

passages.text: Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will incite your lovers against you, those from whom you turned away in disgust. And I will bring them against you from every side— the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them—all desirable young men, governors and commanders, officers and men of renown, mounted on horses.
passages.sermon:
Oholibah was a symbol for Jerusalem.
The Lord GOD spoke to Oholibah.
The Lord GOD said, “I will act against you, Oholibah.
I will stir up your lovers against you.
You once turned away from these lovers in disgust.
I will bring these lovers against you from every side.
They are the Babylonians.
They are all the Chaldeans.
They include the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa.
They also include all the Assyrians with them.
All these men are desirable young men.
They are governors and commanders.
They are officers and men of renown.
They all ride on horses.
passages.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָהֳלִיבָ֗ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ הִנְנִ֨י מֵעִ֤יר אֶת־ מְאַהֲבַ֙יִךְ֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשֵׁ֖ךְ מֵהֶ֑ם וַהֲבֵאתִ֥ים עָלַ֖יִךְ מִסָּבִֽיב׃ בְּנֵ֧י בָבֶ֣ל וְכָל־ כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים פְּק֤וֹד וְשׁ֙וֹעַ֙ וְק֔וֹעַ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר אוֹתָ֑ם בַּח֨וּרֵי חֶ֜מֶד פַּח֤וֹת וּסְגָנִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם שָֽׁלִשִׁים֙ וּקְרוּאִ֔ים רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: They will come against you with a host of peoples, with weapons, chariots, and wagons. They will array themselves against you on every side with buckler and shield and helmet. I will delegate judgment to them, and they will punish you according to their own standards.
passages.sermon:
Many nations will come against you.
They will bring a great army.
They will bring weapons.
They will bring chariots.
They will bring wagons.
They will surround you on every side.
They will stand against you with shields.
They will stand against you with bucklers.
They will stand against you with helmets.
I, the Lord, will hand you over to them for judgment.
They will judge you by their own laws.
They will punish you as they see fit.
passages.original: וּבָ֣אוּ עָלַ֡יִךְ הֹ֠צֶן רֶ֤כֶב וְגַלְגַּל֙ וּבִקְהַ֣ל עַמִּ֔ים צִנָּ֤ה וּמָגֵן֙ וְקוֹבַ֔ע יָשִׂ֥ימוּ עָלַ֖יִךְ סָבִ֑יב וְנָתַתִּ֤י לִפְנֵיהֶם֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּשְׁפָט֖וּךְ בְּמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And I will set My jealous rage against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and ears, and your survivors will fall by the sword. They will seize your sons and daughters, and your remnant will be consumed by fire.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Oholibah.
Oholibah represents Jerusalem.
God says, "I will turn my jealous anger against you."
Your enemies will act toward you with fury.
They will cut off your nose and your ears.
Those who survive will die by the sword.
They will take away your sons and your daughters.
Fire will destroy those who remain.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י קִנְאָתִ֜י בָּ֗ךְ וְעָשׂ֤וּ אוֹתָךְ֙ בְּחֵמָ֔ה אַפֵּ֤ךְ וְאָזְנַ֙יִךְ֙ יָסִ֔ירוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ בַּחֶ֣רֶב תִּפּ֑וֹל הֵ֗מָּה בָּנַ֤יִךְ וּבְנוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאַחֲרִיתֵ֖ךְ תֵּאָכֵ֥ל בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry.
passages.sermon: Your enemies will come against you.\r\nThey will remove your clothes.\r\nThey will take your fine jewelry.
passages.original: וְהִפְשִׁיט֖וּךְ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֥י תִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃

passages.text: So I will put an end to your indecency and prostitution, which began in the land of Egypt, and you will not lift your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.’
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jerusalem.
God promises to stop Jerusalem’s indecency.
God will end Jerusalem’s prostitution.
Jerusalem’s prostitution began in Egypt.
God will make Jerusalem stop looking to Egypt.
God will make Jerusalem forget Egypt.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֤י זִמָּתֵךְ֙ מִמֵּ֔ךְ וְאֶת־ זְנוּתֵ֖ךְ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׂאִ֤י עֵינַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמִצְרַ֖יִם לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי־ עֽוֹד׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Surely I will deliver you into the hands of those you hate, from whom you turned away in disgust.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD has all power and authority.
The Lord GOD says this to you.
I will give you into the hands of your enemies.
You hate these people.
You turned away from them in disgust.
You will be delivered to them.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִי֙ נֹֽתְנָ֔ךְ בְּיַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את בְּיַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ נָקְעָ֥ה נַפְשֵׁ֖ךְ מֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They will treat you with hatred, take all for which you have worked, and leave you naked and bare, so that the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your indecency and promiscuity have brought these things upon you, because you have prostituted yourself with the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jerusalem.
Jerusalem has acted with indecency and promiscuity.
God says, "Your enemies will hate you."
They will take everything you have worked for.
They will leave you naked and bare.
Everyone will see your shame.
People will see the disgrace of your prostitution.
People will see your indecency and your unfaithfulness.
These things will happen to you because you prostituted yourself with other nations.
You became unclean by worshiping their idols.
passages.original: וְעָשׂ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜ךְ בְּשִׂנְאָ֗ה וְלָקְחוּ֙ כָּל־ יְגִיעֵ֔ךְ וַעֲזָב֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֑ה וְנִגְלָה֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת זְנוּנַ֔יִךְ וְזִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃ עָשֹׂ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑ךְ בִּזְנוֹתֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ נִטְמֵ֖את בְּגִלּוּלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Because you have followed the path of your sister, I will put her cup into your hand.’
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God is the Lord.
God addresses a woman who has sinned.
This woman has acted like her sister.
Her sister also sinned.
God says the woman followed her sister’s path.
God will give the woman her sister’s cup.
God will place the cup in the woman’s hand.
passages.original: בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ אֲחוֹתֵ֖ךְ הָלָ֑כְתְּ וְנָתַתִּ֥י כוֹסָ֖הּ בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup deep and wide. It will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says this to Jerusalem.
You will drink the cup of your sister.
This cup is deep.
This cup is wide.
This cup will bring you scorn.
This cup will bring you mockery.
This cup holds much.
You will not be able to contain it.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה כּ֤וֹס אֲחוֹתֵךְ֙ תִּשְׁתִּ֔י הָעֲמֻקָּ֖ה וְהָרְחָבָ֑ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לִצְחֹ֛ק וּלְלַ֖עַג מִרְבָּ֥ה לְהָכִֽיל׃

passages.text: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief, with a cup of devastation and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jerusalem.
God says Jerusalem will be filled with drunkenness.
God says Jerusalem will be filled with grief.
God will give Jerusalem a cup of devastation.
God will give Jerusalem a cup of desolation.
This cup is the same as the cup of Samaria, Jerusalem’s sister.
passages.original: שִׁכָּר֥וֹן וְיָג֖וֹן תִּמָּלֵ֑אִי כּ֚וֹס שַׁמָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָ֔ה כּ֖וֹס אֲחוֹתֵ֥ךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: You will drink it and drain it; you will dash it to pieces, and tear your breasts. For I have spoken,’ declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Jerusalem.
Jerusalem has acted like her sister Samaria.
Jerusalem has forgotten God and turned to idols.
God says, “You will drink the cup I give you.
You will drink it completely.
You will drain it to the last drop.
You will smash the cup to pieces.
You will tear your breasts in sorrow.
I, the Lord GOD, have spoken.”
passages.original: וְשָׁתִ֨ית אוֹתָ֜הּ וּמָצִ֗ית וְאֶת־ חֲרָשֶׂ֛יהָ תְּגָרֵ֖מִי וְשָׁדַ֣יִךְ תְּנַתֵּ֑קִי כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because you have forgotten Me and have cast Me behind your back, you must bear the consequences of your indecency and prostitution.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He says this to the people.
You have forgotten Me.
You have thrown Me away.
You put Me behind your back.
You chose to ignore Me.
You acted with indecency.
You committed prostitution.
You must now carry the results of your actions.
You will bear the consequences of your indecency and prostitution.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן שָׁכַ֣חַתְּ אוֹתִ֔י וַתַּשְׁלִ֥יכִי אוֹתִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י גַוֵּ֑ךְ וְגַם־ אַ֛תְּ שְׂאִ֥י זִמָּתֵ֖ךְ וְאֶת־ תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He called me "son of man."
He told me about Oholah and Oholibah.
Oholah and Oholibah are two women who represent Samaria and Jerusalem.
The LORD asked me if I would judge Oholah and Oholibah.
He told me to announce their sins to them.
He told me to declare their abominations.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶֽת־ אָהֳלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ אָהֳלִיבָ֑ה וְהַגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to Me, in the fire as food for their idols.
passages.sermon:
Oholah and Oholibah are two sisters.
They have committed adultery.
They have blood on their hands.
They have committed adultery with their idols.
They have sacrificed their children to their idols.
They gave their own children, whom they bore to God, as food for idols.
passages.original: כִּ֣י נִאֵ֗פוּ וְדָם֙ בִּֽידֵיהֶ֔ן וְאֶת־ גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֖ן נִאֵ֑פוּ וְגַ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָֽלְדוּ־ לִ֔י הֶעֱבִ֥ירוּ לָהֶ֖ם לְאָכְלָֽה׃

passages.text: They have also done this to Me: On that very same day, they defiled My sanctuary and profaned My Sabbaths.
passages.sermon:
The Lord spoke to Ezekiel.
The Lord accused Oholah and Oholibah.
Oholah and Oholibah did evil to the Lord.
On that same day, they defiled the Lord’s sanctuary.
They also profaned the Lord’s Sabbaths.
passages.original: ע֥וֹד זֹ֖את עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֑י טִמְּא֤וּ אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י חִלֵּֽלוּ׃

passages.text: On the very day they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary to profane it. Yes, they did this inside My house.
passages.sermon:
The people killed their children for their idols.
They did this on that same day.
They entered My sanctuary on that day.
They came to defile My holy place.
They did these things inside My house.
passages.original: וּֽבְשַׁחֲטָ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ לְגִלּ֣וּלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לְחַלְּל֑וֹ וְהִנֵּה־ כֹ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ בְּת֥וֹךְ בֵּיתִֽי׃

passages.text: Furthermore, you sisters sent messengers for men who came from afar; and behold, when they arrived, you bathed for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with jewelry.
passages.sermon:
Oholah and Oholibah were sisters.
They acted with unfaithfulness.
You sisters sent messengers.
You sent them to men who lived far away.
A messenger went to those men.
The men came to you.
When the men arrived, you prepared yourself for them.
You bathed yourself.
You painted your eyes.
You put on jewelry.
passages.original: וְאַ֗ף כִּ֤י תִשְׁלַ֙חְנָה֙ לַֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים מִמֶּרְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַלְאָ֜ךְ שָׁל֤וּחַ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְהִנֵּה־ בָ֔אוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר רָחַ֛צְתְּ כָּחַ֥לְתְּ עֵינַ֖יִךְ וְעָ֥דִית עֶֽדִי׃

passages.text: You sat on a couch of luxury with a table spread before it, on which you had set My incense and My oil, accompanied by the sound of a carefree crowd. Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with men from the rabble, who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your head.
passages.sermon:
You sat on a luxurious couch.
A table was set in front of you.
You placed My incense and My oil on the table.
A carefree crowd made noise around you.
Men came in from among many people.
Drunkards arrived from the desert.
These men put bracelets on your wrists.
They placed beautiful crowns on your head.
passages.original: וְיָשַׁבְתְּ֙ עַל־ מִטָּ֣ה כְבוּדָּ֔ה וְשֻׁלְחָ֥ן עָר֖וּךְ לְפָנֶ֑יהָ וּקְטָרְתִּ֥י וְשַׁמְנִ֖י שַׂ֥מְתְּ עָלֶֽיהָ׃ וְק֣וֹל הָמוֹן֮ שָׁלֵ֣ו בָהּ֒ וְאֶל־ אֲנָשִׁים֙ מֵרֹ֣ב אָדָ֔ם מוּבָאִ֥ים סוֹבָאִים מִמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּתְּנ֤וּ צְמִידִים֙ אֶל־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ן וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת עַל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Then I said of her who had grown old in adulteries: ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is!’
passages.sermon:
The woman had grown old in adultery.
She had committed adultery for a long time.
I spoke about her.
I said, "Let them use her as a prostitute."
She is only a prostitute now.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר לַבָּלָ֖ה נִֽאוּפִ֑ים עַתָּ יִזְנֻה תַזְנוּתֶ֖הָ וָהִֽיא׃

passages.text: And they slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
passages.sermon: Oholah and Oholibah were women known for their lewdness.\r\nMen went to them as men go to a prostitute.\r\nMen slept with Oholah and Oholibah as with prostitutes.
passages.original: וַיָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֔יהָ כְּב֖וֹא אֶל־ אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן בָּ֗אוּ אֶֽל־ אָֽהֳלָה֙ וְאֶל־ אָ֣הֳלִיבָ֔ה אִשֹּׁ֖ת הַזִּמָּֽה׃

passages.text: But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment of those who commit adultery and bloodshed, because they are adulteresses with blood on their hands.
passages.sermon:
Righteous men will judge these women.
These men are just and upright.
They will give a sentence for adultery.
They will give a sentence for bloodshed.
These women are adulteresses.
These women have blood on their hands.
passages.original: וַאֲנָשִׁ֣ים צַדִּיקִ֗ם הֵ֚מָּה יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ אֽוֹתְהֶ֔ם מִשְׁפַּט֙ נֹֽאֲפ֔וֹת וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט שֹׁפְכ֣וֹת דָּ֑ם כִּ֤י נֹֽאֲפֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְדָ֖ם בִּֽידֵיהֶֽן׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD gives a command.
He says, “Bring a crowd against these women.
Hand them over to terror.
Hand them over to plunder.”
passages.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הַעֲלֵ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ קָהָ֔ל וְנָתֹ֥ן אֶתְהֶ֖ן לְזַעֲוָ֥ה וְלָבַֽז׃

passages.text: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.
passages.sermon:
A mob will attack these women.
The mob will throw stones at them.
The mob will kill them with swords.
The mob will kill their sons.
The mob will kill their daughters.
The mob will burn down their houses.
passages.original: וְרָגְמ֨וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֥ן אֶ֙בֶן֙ קָהָ֔ל וּבָרֵ֥א אוֹתְהֶ֖ן בְּחַרְבוֹתָ֑ם בְּנֵיהֶ֤ם וּבְנֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ יַהֲרֹ֔גוּ וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ן בָּאֵ֥שׁ יִשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃

passages.text: So I will put an end to indecency in the land, and all the women will be admonished not to imitate your behavior.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He will stop all indecency in the land.
He will make sure indecency ends.
All women will receive a warning.
They must not copy your behavior.
passages.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנִֽוַּסְּרוּ֙ כָּל־ הַנָּשִׁ֔ים וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה כְּזִמַּתְכֶֽנָה׃

passages.text: They will repay you for your indecency, and you will bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
God says, “Others will punish you for your indecent acts.
You will suffer for your sins of idolatry.
You will carry the consequences of your actions.
Then you will know that I am the Lord God.”
passages.original: וְנָתְנ֤וּ זִמַּתְכֶ֙נָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ן וַחֲטָאֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵיכֶ֖ן תִּשֶּׂ֑אינָה וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
